Rules.InvariantScript:
User().FullName & " - " & If(
    Find(".", Office365Users.MyProfile().Department) > 0,
    Left(Office365Users.MyProfile().Department, Find(".", Office365Users.MyProfile().Department) - 1),
    Office365Users.MyProfile().Department
)
"Draft  (" & Text(CountRows(Filter(colMyReqs, varUserRole = "ADMINISTRATOR" Or 'Created By'.Email = User().Email, Status.Value = "Draft"))) & ")"
"Pending  (" & Text(CountRows(Filter(colMyReqs, varUserRole = "ADMINISTRATOR" Or 'Created By'.Email = User().Email, Status.Value = "Pending"))) & ")"
"Approved  (" & Text(CountRows(Filter(colMyReqs, varUserRole = "ADMINISTRATOR" Or 'Created By'.Email = User().Email, Status.Value = "Approved"))) & ")"
"Rejected  (" & Text(CountRows(Filter(colMyReqs, varUserRole = "ADMINISTRATOR" Or 'Created By'.Email = User().Email, Status.Value = "Rejected"))) & ")"
"Published  (" & Text(CountRows(Filter(colMyReqs, varUserRole = "ADMINISTRATOR" Or 'Created By'.Email = User().Email, Status.Value = "Published"))) & ")"

Sort(
    Filter(
        colMyReqs,
        varUserRole = "ADMINISTRATOR" Or 'Created By'.Email = User().Email,
        varFilter = "All" Or Status.Value = varFilter,
        varFilterDG = "All" Or IsBlank(varFilterDG) Or DG.Value = varFilterDG,
        (IsBlank(HomeFilterRequestID.Text) Or HomeFilterRequestID.Text = "" Or StartsWith(RequestNumber, HomeFilterRequestID.Text)) And
        (IsBlank(HomeFilterRequestName.Text) Or HomeFilterRequestName.Text = "" Or StartsWith(RequestTitle, HomeFilterRequestName.Text)),
        IsEmpty(cmbFilterRequestor.SelectedItems) Or "All" in cmbFilterRequestor.SelectedItems.Value Or 'Created By'.DisplayName in cmbFilterRequestor.SelectedItems.Value,
        IsBlank(varFilterStartDate) Or StartRequestDate >= varFilterStartDate,
        IsBlank(varFilterEndDate) Or EndRequestDate <= varFilterEndDate,
        IsBlank(locProdTypeFilter) Or
            !IsEmpty(
                Filter(
                    colMyMedia,
                    ParentRequest = RequestNumber And First(MediaType).Value = locProdTypeFilter
                )
            )
    ),
    Modified, SortOrder.Descending
)

Filter(

    varFilter = "All" Or Status.Value = varFilter,

    IsBlank(varFilterRequestName) Or varFilterRequestName = "" Or StartsWith(RequestTitle, varFilterRequestName) Or StartsWith(RequestNumber, varFilterRequestName),
    IsEmpty(cmbFilterRequestor.SelectedItems) Or "All" in cmbFilterRequestor.SelectedItems.Value Or 'Created By'.DisplayName in cmbFilterRequestor.SelectedItems.Value,
    IsBlank(varFilterStartDate) Or StartRequestDate >= varFilterStartDate,
    IsBlank(varFilterEndDate) Or EndRequestDate <= varFilterEndDate,

            )
        )
),
    Modified, SortOrder.Descending
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
Switch(
    locProdTypeFilter,
 "Photo", "📷 " & ThisItem.RequestNumber,
    "Podcast", "🎙️ " & ThisItem.RequestNumber,
    "Video", "🎬 " & ThisItem.RequestNumber,
    ThisItem.RequestNumber
)

If("Approved" in ThisItem.Status.Value, Color.DarkGreen,
   "Pending" in ThisItem.Status.Value, Color.Orange,
   "Draft" in ThisItem.Status.Value, Color.Gray,
   "Rejected" in ThisItem.Status.Value, Color.Red,
   "Published" in ThisItem.Status.Value, Color.DarkOrchid,
   Color.Gray)
"Open in review queue to approve or reject"
"No requests yet - press the button + New request to create your first one."

Text(CountRows(HomeGallery.AllItems)) & If(CountRows(HomeGallery.AllItems) = 1, "  request", "  requests") & "   " &
If(
    CountRows(Filter(HomeGallery.AllItems, Status.Value = "Rejected")) > 0,
    "⚠  " & Text(CountRows(Filter(HomeGallery.AllItems, Status.Value = "Rejected"))) & " rejected",
    If(
        CountRows(HomeGallery.AllItems) > 0
        And CountRows(Filter(HomeGallery.AllItems, Status.Value = "Approved")) = CountRows(HomeGallery.AllItems),
        "✓  all approved",
        If(
            CountRows(Filter(HomeGallery.AllItems, Status.Value = "Draft")) > 0,
            "◌  " & Text(CountRows(Filter(HomeGallery.AllItems, Status.Value = "Draft"))) & " in draft",
            ""
        )
    )
)

If(
    CountIf(HomeGallery.AllItems, Status.Value = "Rejected") > 0,
    RGBA(193, 40, 40, 1),
    If(
        CountRows(HomeGallery.AllItems) > 0
        And CountIf(HomeGallery.AllItems, Status.Value = "Approved") = CountRows(HomeGallery.AllItems),
        RGBA(22, 128, 80, 1),
        RGBA(96, 104, 120, 1)
    )
)
